steps.en: OCMS receives the permanent suspension request from PLUS
steps.id: OCMS menerima request permanent suspension dari PLUS

steps.en: PLUS can fetch the allowed suspension codes
steps.id: PLUS bisa mengambil daftar kode suspension yang diizinkan

steps.en: Missing required fields in the request are rejected
steps.id: Field wajib yang kosong pada request ditolak
steps.why_en: A permanent suspension request is also rejected when it lacks a revival-days field it does not need.
steps.why_id: Request permanent suspension juga ditolak bila tanpa field hari revival yang sebenarnya tidak diperlukan.

steps.en: Requests are always treated as coming from PLUS
steps.id: Request selalu diperlakukan berasal dari PLUS

steps.en: Each notice in the request is handled separately
steps.id: Tiap notice dalam request ditangani terpisah

steps.en: OCMS checks that PLUS may use the requested code
steps.id: OCMS mengecek apakah PLUS boleh memakai kode yang diminta

steps.en: PLUS can check eligibility without applying the suspension
steps.id: PLUS bisa mengecek kelayakan tanpa menerapkan suspension
steps.why_en: The check-only mode applies different rules than the real apply, so answers can differ.
steps.why_id: Mode cek-saja memakai aturan berbeda dari penerapan sebenarnya, jadi jawabannya bisa berbeda.
